scope: isolated actual HTTPS HTTP/1.1 on loopback, durable synthetic replies; no production load, WAN, NIC or long-term capacity guarantee

environment.other_services: live services remained running; trials executed sequentially

comparison.before: 77baaad3793e: raw WAL/gzip snapshots, optional queue1024; includes previous backlog handling improvement
comparison.after: d4d6991c566e: final storage Zstd with raw small single frames and optional queue2048
comparison.interpretation: combined implementation comparison; optional queue change prevents attributing all logging changes solely to Zstd

policy.reply_limits: default 1000-response limit retained; measurement threads precreated, <=750 planned replies per hot thread in rotate mode
policy.workload: 80% legacy realistic synthetic ~400-byte body and 20% shorter Web post; Web form/CSRF/303/follow-up included
policy.arrival: bounded actors, one in-flight logical post each; missed actor slots are unsent, not successes; no retry of failed measured post
policy.throughput: successful response completed within measurement window; separate drain-inclusive total
policy.stability: all planned accepted, no unsent/errors, >=99% completed in window, scheduled p95 <=250ms, exact DAT and all recovery100 accepted; measurement criterion, not an SLO
policy.recovery: after main load drains, 100 actual posts at20/s; latency reported separately
policy.logs: normal-shutdown queue accounting covers preparation, load, recovery and verification; posting priority may cause optional loss at saturation
policy.WAF: enabled only in labelled trials; ordinary client/global traffic budgets increased by existing isolated helper, fixed posting60/s burst120 and simultaneous32 retained; rejections are not storage capacity
policy.reads: optional40 actors (32 identity full DAT,8 gzip Web), planned2000/s; skipped polls reported; no change to DAT206 handling
